anise

The goal of anise is to provide an easy access to the data of the Atlas of marine Non-Indigenous Species in Europe through a Shiny App or load them directly in the R user environment for further analysis.

Installation

You can install the development version of anise from GitHub with:

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("xx/xx")

Example

Shiny App

After loading the R package, you can launch the shiny app with:

library(anise)

shiny_anise()

Loading the datasets

You can also load the different datasets through:

data_anise()

or individual dataset using:

taxo_tbl
inv_tbl
origin_tbl
meow

See the package documentation for the description of the different datasets.
